notes.title: MEET the Exosuit ES-1 "Wildcat"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, brothers in arms![/p][p]Today we're back to two-legged vehicles; we'll be talking about the "small" [b]ES-1 "Wildcat"[/b] exosuit![/p][p][/p][p]At first glance, the Wildcat might look like a mech, but my intention is to make it an exosuit.[/p][p]The difference?[/p][p]A mech is something imposing, a sort of earth-shaking bipod tank, armed with powerful, sci-fi weapons.[/p][p]An exosuit is a sort of mini-mech, meaning it's much cheaper than a mech, much less armed and armored than a mech, but easier to use.[/p][p][/p][p]For a player, calling a mech onto the battlefield will cost credits.[/p][p]Calling an exosuit, on the other hand, should be a relatively cheap action, aimed at getting out of a difficult situation like being surrounded or countering a certain threat for which the player is not equipped.[/p][p][/p][p]In this case, the ES-1 Wildcat is designed for "anti-infantry" tasks, meaning the elimination of small, lightly armored enemies, thanks to its armament: a 7.62 mm rotary machine gun and a 40 mm grenade launcher.[/p][p]If you're surrounded by numerous ants or infantry without anti-tank weapons, calling in a Wildcat could save your life.[/p][p][/p][p]For this reason, I'd like to make deploying exosuits (yes, there will be more than one) much faster than calling in vehicles, coming close to calling the Titan in Titanfall.[/p][p][/p][p]What do you think?[/p][p]If you have any suggestions, please let me know; maybe an idea will emerge that will improve the game for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/4bd0d707dd78627a4f5c131c550cbc9abefbbce3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/22a574a04cb1f74f548ffb7f5c9adf5e3c995583.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f1c1124947b4e85f5e75f02842dbbf4d0ac53daa.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/d23b6ad2a981dac733443919765fd98d3ea42c6f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the Light Cruiser "Silverwind"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]I've noticed that many of you are primarily interested in the naval aspect of the game, which is nice because it's a type of warfare that has always attracted me.[/p][p][/p][p]I remember when I was little and my parents took me to the seaside; I spent hours on the rocks reading books about World War II naval battles that my father had bought me. There weren't many pictures in those books, so my imagination ran wild, and the real smell of salt air gave my imagination a more realistic feel.[/p][p][/p][p]Back to us, today I present to you the light cruiser: "[b]Silverwind[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]Light cruisers are ships capable of operating autonomously in a variety of missions, but they are at their best when used to hold off smaller vessels.[/p][p]These ships are fast and quite imposing, although they can't match the might of a dreadnought.[/p][p][/p][p]The Silverwind can accommodate four crew members.[/p][p]All can use 12.7 mm machine guns and 40 mm flak cannons.[/p][p]The first three members have two turrets (front and rear) with each equipped with two 155 mm guns.[/p][p]The fourth member cannot use guns, but has two triple torpedo launchers, which are lethal against slower-moving targets.[/p][p]You can see how, if each member equipped themselves with anti-aircraft weapons, this ship would be able to enforce a naval "no-fly zone" within its weapons' range, something larger ships cannot do.[/p][p][/p][p]The Silverwind's two main weaknesses are:[/p][p]- the lack of truly heavy armor;[/p][p]- the lack of weapons for attacking units below the surface of the sea.[/p][p][/p][p]How would you use this vessel in battle?[/p][p]Do you have friends who would like to share steel and salt with you?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/4b3e9ffc4519431bee241982d326760e2d03504d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/98666c991e9ac79ff5253784c7a68986ae3a1e58.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/3d65560e690ee3cfbe3ec6dbbd0a2e90de9acdea.png"][/img][/p][p][img notes.title: ABOUT GAMEPLAY: unlocks and calls for vehicles
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p][b]Today I won't be showing you any new units, but I wanted to talk about a very specific game mechanic: how to use vehicles?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I want to clarify that I'll use the word "vehicles" for convenience, but by that I mean: vehicles, mechs, planes, helicopters, ships, boats, submarines, and any other metallic devilry I can think of.[/p][p][/p][p]In FPS/TPS games, there are generally two ways to use vehicles:[/p][p]1) You find them scattered around the map[/p][p]2) You summon them from outside the map[/p][p]Simple.[/p][p][/p][p]Personally, I find advantages and disadvantages in both methods:[/p][p]1) It's a democratic method of distributing vehicles, but it's frustrating if you want to use a single-seater plane and there are five other players in line before you (perhaps even good ones who never get shot down!). Furthermore, the variety of vehicles is inevitably limited, and you often have to make do with what you find.[/p][p]2) A "capitalist" way to use a vehicle, meaning if you have some kind of money, you can call it in; otherwise, you're completely on your own. The advantage is that you can call it in whenever you want, and you can call in the exact vehicle you want.[/p][p][/p][p]In "Home Wars: Battlefield," I'm trying to circumvent these problems by creating a hybrid system.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How does this hybrid system work?[/b][/h3][p]Basically, the player can call in the vehicle they want in battle, but there will also be other vehicles on the map, of random value, that the player and bots can use.[/p][p]Let me explain.[/p][p]During battle, the player will accumulate a sort of credits (I'm not sure how yet) that they can spend in the match to call in the vehicles they want. Obviously, better vehicles will cost more.[/p][p]Once spawned, these vehicles can be used by anyone and in any player/bot combination.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Can the player use all vehicles from the start of the game?[/b][/h3][p]No.[/p][p]At the end of each battle, depending on the outcome, players will receive another type of credit that they can spend to unlock new vehicles in a dedicated offline menu.[/p][p]The same goes for soldier weapons, insects, and dinosaurs.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Can you give us an example?[/b][/h3][p]I can give you an example.[/p][p]Let's say you and your trusty squad are surrounded by small, lightly armored insects, but desperate to exterminate humanity. You realize you're ill-equipped for such a fight, because you have a sniper rifle, one of your teammates has a sniper rifle, one uses only anti-tank weapons, and another enjoys setting mines and barricades.[/p][p]It doesn't take Napoleon to realize that you'll soon be cannon fodder.[/p][p]So, thanks to your unlocks, you can summon a nice modern tank onto the battlefield, perhaps equipped with a cannon, flamethrower, top turrets, and maybe even a nice mortar.[/p][p]That would be cool, right?[/p][p]You can do it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How do you earn credits to unlock vehicles offline?[/b][/h3][p]As I said, they should be earned by winning battles and/or opening specific chests during combat.[/p][p]If you have any ideas, please share them![/p][p][/p][h3][b]How do you earn credits to summon vehicles into battle?[/b][/h3][p]Well, I don't know the exact method, but I have a variety of options. Tell me in the comments which one you think is best:[/p][p]- Credits accrue over time, regardless of whether the player is playing or looking for errors in the game and then giving me a bad review.[/p][p]- Credits are awarded based on your own: kills, damage inflicted, and objectives achieved.[/p][p]- Same as the previous point, but shared by the entire team.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Please give me your opinion; it's essential to me.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]What type of vehicle would you like to use most?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3]

notes.title: MEET the "Lion"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]This week, we're starting with a bang![/p][p]I present to you a vehicle that is an icon of an era and a country: the "[b]Lion[/b]" heavy tank!!![/p][p][/p][p]You've almost certainly recognized it: it's the legendary Tiger 1, used by Germany during World War II![/p][p]This tank was a veritable bunker on tracks for its time, as feared as it was expensive to produce and maintain.[/p][p]At the time of its introduction, there was likely no other tank in the world capable of beating it in 1v1 combat, which is why its enemies had to surround and attack it simultaneously to overcome this metal beast.[/p][p][/p][p]In the game, the Lion will be a heavily armored heavy tank equipped with an 88 mm cannon and a pair of 7.62 mm machine guns.[/p][p]Its task will be to break through enemy lines head-on![/p][p]Will it be the most powerful tank in the game? No, it will probably be the more modern tanks, which will have many more weapons on board and slightly better armor. However, this beast will be less expensive than its more recent counterparts so that it can be used multiple times in the same battle.[/p][p][/p][p]Can you imagine using it in some joint tactics with our friends or rushing headlong into the enemy objective alone?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/aeb4facaf4cba336f1202f8d8af7e4a278b634c3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/ca149c41a0dd30af2b92d03ded49f4051d29a45c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/3128a30f759b7ef785d0b7ad67c39f8ff47e1a66.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c522a1ed3dc7200c7d3ef85fd3528628ffbf8df7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/58b9ca9c6cb3eba66b41d9f50afe6f8d3a13a48c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/49e1ca8571429f284ac967f0b25c47e0642bf2e4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b4bee88d9a54e69a1a11d14990d894b016f0a180.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Baron"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, I bring you a historical gem: an aircraft that's extremely rare in the world of video games, the "[b]Baron[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]You'll say, "What the hell are you talking about? That name doesn't exist!"[/p][p]You're right, in fact, its real name is Fokker Dr.I... does that mean anything to you?[/p][p]Probably not, that's understandable.[/p][p]What if I said "Red Baron"?[/p][p]If that doesn't mean anything to you either, please go back to playing soccer video games!!![/p][p][/p][p]As many of you know, the Red Baron was a German flying ace in World War I! He flew his legendary Fokker Dr.I, painted completely red, hence the name.[/p][p][/p][p]The Fokker Dr.I was a fighter aircraft, and that's precisely what it will be in the game, where it'll be armed with two 7.62 mm machine guns that the pilot can use.[/p][p]Now, many will come to my house with pitchforks to tell me that wasn't the original caliber, but, as I've answered others, I'm combining weapons and vehicles from over a century of military history belonging to different countries, and therefore with completely different calibers. For my own sanity, I'm trying to group as many calibers as possible into a few categories to manage the game's balance better.[/p][p][/p][p]Returning to the Baron, it will be a triplane fighter, very light, with a low cruising speed and a strong will to win![/p][p]As a World War I aircraft, and considering the advanced technology of the F-22 in the game, I need to characterize it in a way that doesn't render it entirely useless for the player.[/p][p]For this reason, it will be the first unlockable fighter and therefore the cheapest to call into battle.[/p][p]It won't be able to compete against more modern aircraft, but it will be a good option for taking down bombers from its era and even for taking down some unarmored ground enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to comment below.[/p][p]See you at the next MEET![/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/100d673a5c52d77f22e9b202919679a0e7da8baa.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/a75edb82c43f32357ca6ada8b9743750e5ef14b8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/e3083f6efe4288459e33aa14575d6ac522a5a8d3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f5ea68a1b9c0590f34fe673b1f5b8549b325986b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/74fda730f9726a7ffd2363070b819965fd3c8f09.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b00279bb0eb27e444fe11f58c32cb74a9da266cf.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/ba4b38c04939b22b5d7dbeb70b58e12fda3a9f00.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the SBM-2 "Shark"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, my brothers in arms![/p][p]Today, I take you beneath the icy ocean waves, into the presence of one who feeds on salt and steel: the [b]SBM-2 "Shark"[/b] submarine![/p][p][/p][p]Military history buffs will immediately notice how much this model recalls the military submarines of World War II, and indeed, it is inspired by them.[/p][p]When technology was still secondary to human courage, the intrepid sailors who sailed the depths in the belly of this metallic monster laid the foundations for a new type of warfare: submarine warfare.[/p][p][/p][p]Underwater battles are much slower and more strategic than surface battles, where every submarine and every ship is a piece in a great chess game.[/p][p]In my game, I'm trying to convey this abysmal slowness, this alternate passage of time, where the soldier will be enveloped in solitude and darkness, but it won't be that easy, as it will be part of a much faster gameplay.[/p][p]As always, I'll do my best![/p][p][/p][p]The Shark is a large submarine with two crew members.[/p][p]Don't be fooled by the fact that it's "vintage," otherwise you'll soon be joining the fish.[/p][p]The helmsman will be in command of the vessel and will be able to launch the fearsome torpedoes from six launch tubes. Furthermore, he will have a dual 12.7 mm machine gun, designed primarily for anti-aircraft defense (yes, there are torpedo bombers too!), but also very useful for dispatching small surface enemies.[/p][p]The second crew member will also have the same machine gun, located on the rear, and a powerful 105 mm cannon. Obviously, this weapon won't be able to fire while submerged, but it will prove to be a powerful weapon against surface targets, such as small ships, boats, and hostile marine life. It could also prove excellent for sinking larger ships if they're already dead and you want to save your precious torpedoes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Speaking of torpedoes![/b][/p][p]This game features several types of torpedoes, from the more classic to the more technologically advanced; the type of torpedo carried will depend on the type of vessel.[/p][p]In this case, the Shark carries classic torpedoes, the slow and inexorable ones that only move in the direction they are launched.[/p][p]Although they lack autonomous target-finding capabilities, they have the great advantage of being inexpensive, which means they can be transported in large numbers before returning to refuel.[/p][p][/p][p]In "Home Wars: Battlefield," there will be several types of submarines, including strategic ones for hitting land targets, but these will be revealed gradually as development progresses.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, enjoy these preview images and share your thoughts and suggestions in the comments.[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD WATER BUG IS A DEAD WATER BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/a7c84e8107f54f98f33f7e729bade155c4fcd498.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/bf711b50818a5697431fc270f4cb0d506e20aab8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/5cc12139a875774971b0d79380030327c1be149e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/0abeb52a3c7bbca59266986117cab6e67fca84d0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/64566695ef7e51b9f02e0bceb79fad97e977473f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/fe19f9ea8e3a7128ce06c9e10367878cc08517aa.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/1252fa230b769b9aeeeee208495e8235ab5ce50c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f214eba69414014db58744629956b505c5654b99.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the Assault Mech MH-1 "Prometheus"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today is starting to feel a bit sci-fi, but squashing insects requires firepower beyond the ordinary![/p][p]Introducing the [b]MH-1 "Prometheus" Assault Mech[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]This mech is designed to assault enemy lines conventionally and without frills![/p][p]Two crew members operate it:[/p][p]- The first, in addition to being the pilot, has two 12.7 mm rotating machine guns, excellent for faster targets, and two large pods containing 127 mm high-explosive rockets. For now, I'm undecided about using the pods for two different types of ammunition.[/p][p]- The second is responsible for ensuring a secure perimeter for the vehicle; he can count on a quad 7.62 mm machine gun and two small pods containing 20 mm rockets.[/p][p][/p][p]One of this beast's most significant advantages is also one of its greatest weaknesses: its height.[/p][p]This provides excellent visibility on the battlefield, allowing it to target enemies hiding behind cover. However, it can also be hit by enemies far away, creating a large enough silhouette to be easily hit.[/p][p][/p][p]I already have a series of classes of this type of mech ready, such as an anti-tank version, an anti-aircraft version, and an anti-infantry version, among others.[/p][p]I've also prepared 3D models of some "vehicles" that are neither mechs nor exosuits, but something in between.[/p][p][/p][p]I dedicate this mech to the memory of the "big chickens" from BF2142, one of the best games of all time.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions, please feel free to write and I'll be happy to answer them :)[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c9c300281304b90d92440872b9facb97dd761852.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/7cdec87862589a8f8804459f906334e2a27f121b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/e6d42889438d76404810e90947ddf7330ea8131d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/bd1c6dd5221921bfff664643d3e5b40ab318237b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6957766b38311cb967df7c451730a68a390f50ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/535a7014d00a9a1f8a46e6d72a70c92e612f9b35.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/22fb6c2c53622944c4853a0bd317953afa7d84d0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b3f90a3f7ffe171825dbac737b55e0ef39ebf1bc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Aedes albopictus"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, we're switching sides and analyzing one of our future adversaries: the "[b]Aedes albopictus[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]The Aedes albopictus, also known as the tiger mosquito, is a tiny insect, as small as it is annoying.[/p][p]Mosquitoes generally strike at night, but not these! They're so brazen that they strike during the day, in plain sight, confident in their superiority and driven by their insatiable thirst for human blood![/p][p]Just think, the Aedes albopictus is among the 100 most harmful invasive species in the world.[/p][p]How many beautiful summer afternoons have been ruined by the arrival of a pack of these damned creatures that started tearing your legs apart?[/p][p]But now, thanks to HWB, you can repay them some of the pain they suffered, even if only virtually.[/p][p][/p][p]In the game, the Aedes albopictus are slow-flying insects with little resistance to enemy attacks.[/p][p]"A walk in the park," you might say, but it's not![/p][p]This insect's attack is powerful compared to its resistance; it can also regenerate health after each successful attack. Of course, it's not a solitary animal, so when you spot it, it'll most likely be within a formation of Aedes albopictus, which becomes very dangerous in groups.[/p][p][/p][p]To counter this creature, all you need are arm weapons, good aim (because they're thin), and medium-low anti-aircraft armaments. Forget the more sophisticated anti-aircraft guns; those are best for hornets, jets, and pterodactyls![/p][p][/p][p]If you want to play as these infamous creatures, know that speed isn't your best bet.[/p][p]Stay out of sight of the enemy as much as possible, and then, when you're close enough, hit them as many times as you can, perhaps moving in circles.[/p][p]In fact, if you think about it, in gameplay, you should be just as annoying as they are to us![/p][p][/p][p]In the photos below, I've quickly simulated what a group attack on a poor soldier might look like.[/p][p][b]Do you think the soldier would have died or not?[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p]( ... these are annoying even to death because they leave a blood stain on your fingers and you have to wash them afterwards!)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b3d0c094c79aa8a6ee1da468f0312a8bf7026df3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/4311f3a72f59089c51bd5e163f3aad20f264d924.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6331cd1cb354ae61cfe6b7e573e99ef4fa3212af.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/7cb9542e1d21d8d1c9cbcea7a50974c5d771a769.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/9236fa81cdec414bc91ffde853ee11860316d7eb.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/bc7a531228354ba32f9cb5c4ba1ac9fe644f2689.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c00800906175496a1f17242b965b028f0ca96f27.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "F-14 Mav"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, I bring you my favorite aircraft of all time (and I'm sure others will agree).[/p][p]Today, I present to you the legendary "[b]F-14 Mav[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]Of course, I can't use the original names, but I tried to get as close as possible to retain the spirit of that movie we all loved![/p][p][/p][p]The F-14 was born as an interceptor and was widely used by the Navy.[/p][p]Its strengths, besides its aesthetics (which makes me feel like a teenager at my favorite boy band concert every time I see it), were its powerful engines, a highly advanced radar, and above all, its armament.[/p][p]This aircraft's AA missiles had an insane range for its time, which could lead to its enemies being destroyed before they even knew of the existence of good old "Tommy."[/p][p][/p][p]In my game, I tried to maintain the "sacredness" I have for this aircraft, without forcing it to be the best of all the others (and I tell you, there are SO MANY!).[/p][p]In translating our Mav from reality to the video game, I ran into a significant problem: in the front, there's the pilot, who's incredibly cool, we all know that, but in the back, there's another crew member... what the hell do I make the second crew member do???[/p][p]In reality, he was in charge of managing the powerful radar and maintaining communications, but in my game, this made no sense.[/p][p]So that amazing BF3 mission aboard the plane comes in handy![/p][p]Reworking the idea a bit, the second crew member will have additional AA missiles at his disposal and will be able to lock onto enemies independently, obviously taking into account the trajectory of his own plane.[/p][p][/p][p]Both crew members will have a certain number of missiles, likely of different power and different locking methods. One of these two missiles will be unique to the F-14 Mav (this is my little tribute to the king) and will have the greatest range and power compared to the other AA missiles. Obviously, even more powerful missiles can be launched from the ground. The pilot will also be able to use a 20mm rotary cannon, great for close-in enemies and when the cool missiles run out![/p][p][/p][p][b]In short:[/b] the Mav will be an interceptor fighter, therefore geared exclusively for air superiority.[/p][p]It can have two crew members, both with offensive capabilities and health insurance![/p][p]What are the king of the skies' main enemies?[/p][p]Definitely ground-based anti-aircraft, although it will also be able to rely on flares.[/p][p]Furthermore, fast units like flies, dragonflies, and the most modern stealth aircraft, which missiles can't lock on to, could give it a hard time.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, and tell all your friends, because I'm trying to include so many units and vehicles that it will take you weeks to test them all![/p][p][/p][p][b]PS:[/b] In the photos below, you will also find a very accurate, high-definition reconstruction of the most famous scene from the film that we all love.[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/8845fa72e6af50473db6fdb2fddeaed0dc4a69b1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c7fcad1e177575965c7ec2cea6a9f0ccf7d09931.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/028c725fa9d6425c4d7348991201ae2f91defad4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6ddbd559b0eb09210383e8015c61eece870330f8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6d1aeed519c104e84e6832d6beb06c4ae5b73ee9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c962aed089f2d7904033a489d4c8e033365793cd.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/b8b328d7e421ac296e19ad23dcff70554f1435bb.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Boxer"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, my brothers in arms![/p][p]Today, we go back in time and introduce you to one of the gladiators of the past: the "[b]Boxer[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]The Boxer is a tank designed to counter other armored threats. It doesn't have a turret, but it does have a dangerous 75mm frontal gun, equipped with a small range of motion. This gun is equipped with armor-piercing rounds, ideal for penetrating enemy armor.[/p][p]In addition to the gun, it has four 7.62mm machine guns mounted on each side, perfect for defending the tank's perimeter.[/p][p][/p][p]The Boxer is capable of entering and exiting dangerous situations on its own, as long as they aren't excessively dangerous.[/p][p]It is relatively slow, and its armor isn't particularly thick.[/p][p]The Boxer's most suitable role is probably as an anti-armor sniper tank.[/p][p][/p][p]The Boxer is clearly inspired by a WW1 tank. Can you tell me which one?[/p][p][/p][p]Ironically, I wanted to nickname it the "baguette tank," but I later realized that might be offensive to our French comrades.[/p][p][/p][p]I still have a ton of other units to show you![/p][p][b]Do you prefer[/b] me to post twice a week (Monday and Thursday) or three times a week (Monday, Wednesday, and Friday)?[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions, leave them in the comments and I'll get back to you shortly, as always! <3[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/62566d1741306bb0206e4d51bcd36fbf335d797a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/28515b67c3d421b7b8b2a078fb285e21db4c17e7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f9de1b4b5ccf9a30fca0422bd91776097080bca9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/8174c24cb1cbd6532958452111b72bde30d61787.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/5c5dfc8c9d83c98c3b11f3a8781f0c1cc09966c0.png"][/img][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f4a54ac1dca318bed72e895e028835b08827c71f.png"][/img][/h3]

notes.title: MEET the "Kingfisher"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, my brave soldiers![/p][p]Today, I present to you an aircraft that I hope will give you an idea of ​​the breadth of gameplay and the complexity of development of this game: the "[b]Kingfisher[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]There came a point in human history when ships no longer mastered the vast ocean surfaces and began to feel vulnerable. From fearless battleships, they gradually became small, high-tech vessels.[/p][p]When did the nobility of armor give way to the cowardice of agility?[/p][p]This point was when someone first thought of loading a torpedo onto an airplane.[/p][p]A torpedo bomber combines the incredible agility and speed of an airplane with the extreme lethality of a torpedo.[/p][p][/p][p]The Kingfisher is a biplane equipped with a single, powerful torpedo.[/p][p]Your attack tactic is simple to understand, but not so easy to execute. Its pilot must get within a few meters of the water's surface, calculate the target's speed and direction, and release the torpedo at the optimal moment. All this must be done while anti-aircraft fire is pounding you, enemy fighters are targeting you, and your target is taking evasive maneuvers.[/p][p]However, you have a small advantage: you can bring along a second crew member who is "supposed" to help you against enemy fighters using a 7.62mm machine gun and perhaps by identifying your most suitable targets.[/p][p]Furthermore, with only one torpedo, you'll have to refuel after each attack.[/p][p][/p][p]You can see why playing as a torpedo bomber is more of a calling than a choice. However, the satisfaction of watching steel beasts go down thanks to a well-organized squadron of friends is priceless.[/p][p][/p][p]I already have graphics for other torpedo bombers from various eras, including helicopters![/p][p][/p][p]Can you tell me which aircraft this 3D model was taken from?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/1a71c852850478f9baffb56dd87027e49de88b00.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/1cd5cc4fab744e6eef366d215d72b998a547defe.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/aff19411a16206673ccfca567fe3c962c62f838b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/be197d43da198208543195abb0b57e2ef7aa2338.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/58ab45e75e33d1ac4be85a7d85586fb4c4dc02eb.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/88a957b3ae496f9478087bf283a01cb89dd8d6e6.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Goby"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, I present to you the smallest armed boat in the game: the "[b]Goby[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]In the images below, you can see it compared to the inflatable boat we've already discussed.[/p][p]The Goby can accommodate at least three crew members, one as the driver and the other two as gunners.[/p][p]The front weapon is the main one, a twin 12.7 mm machine gun, excellent against lightly armored targets.[/p][p]The rear weapon is a simple 7.62 mm machine gun, just enough to provide rear cover in case of pursuit.[/p][p][/p][p]What is the role of the Goby?[/p][p]It can have multiple uses:[/p][p]- It can be a heavy version of a simple inflatable boat.[/p][p]- It can be a fast, armed version of a heavier boat.[/p][p]- Being inexpensive, it can be an expendable vessel for some tactical purpose![/p][p][/p][p]Using the Goby to attack a battleship is simply a waste of your debris, but combining speed and handling skill could be very effective against smaller aquatic targets without spending too many credits![/p][p][/p][p][b]What do you think you'll use this light boat for?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]See you below in the comments, and see you at the next "MEET!" Please comment as many times as possible. I'd love to answer![/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/8be22481e931a5b75e3d816de20951871f5bd5d7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/8dd5608718c2a4db634b1635fdccdac63db737bd.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/ebe2a4b682d687049f714a6dd0f9c6b82d9382c4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/8da0b938176ee44ca6ca95149cb42b1e7793177e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/0eb8701acdada583283294fe1609c558f1cf1a5e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "AH-64 Sioux"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Soldiers![/p][p]Today, it's our turn to introduce one of the Military's flagships: the "[b]AH-64 Sioux"[/b]![/p][p]The Sioux is a two-seater attack helicopter, specialized for anti-tank combat and lightly armored to increase its crew's survival rate in the heaviest battles.[/p][p][/p][p]The pilot sits in the raised rear seat, while the gunner sits in the front.[/p][p]The pilot has fire-and-forget anti-tank missiles and small-caliber rockets to saturate an enemy area, excellent for lightly armored targets.[/p][p]The gunner controls the high-penetration 30mm autocannon, designed purely as an anti-tank weapon, and TV-guided anti-tank missiles.[/p][p]The powerful engine and light armor allow the aircraft to attack and retreat easily, despite its considerable weight.[/p][p]Obviously, the cost of recalling it to the battlefield will be commensurate with its firepower.[/p][p][/p][p]The positions of the Sioux and all other vehicles are completely interchangeable between players and bots.[/p][p]For example, for the aircraft presented here, the possible crew configurations are:[/p][p]- Pilot: Player / Gunner: Player[/p][p]- Pilot: Player / Gunner: Bot[/p][p]- Pilot: Bot / Gunner: Player[/p][p]- Pilot: Bot / Gunner: Bot[/p][p][/p][p]This war machine is capable of taking down any threat in a flash: armored vehicles, heavy insects, and rock-hard dinosaurs.[/p][p][/p][p]Although I've already modeled the other Military helicopters, let me know which other helicopters you'd like to see/fly in HOME WARS: BATTLEFIELD![/p][p][/p][p]Do you enjoy this sort of devblog where I gradually introduce you to the new title?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/d05a9775a0bec74ac25435ed4036a2ad38a7d9d0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/2f4308ebd4dcc78aec5771a2b766739fd669f08b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/95fcddcdef3976fbf47b994b8c0eca1c4e5751df.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/50390587dbaba1481caed91789795894d7afe7d1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c2b693f249fa72db392851efdeb99e92c8a14d8c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/d59f99d9e74ed1986f1f091b36b3c57108ce2780.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Duke"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, I present to you the "[b]Duke[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]The Duke is a medium tank, quite unusual compared to its peers. It's tall, not heavily armored, but equipped with two independent guns and a crew of three.[/p][p][/p][p]Our friend's [b]armament[/b] consists of:[/p][p]- a 40mm cannon and a coaxial 7.62mm machine gun for the driver.[/p][p]- a 75mm cannon designed to destroy other armored units, but with a limited firing range.[/p][p]- a 7.62mm machine gun located on top of the turret, essential for defending the perimeter from the bravest enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]Being a medium tank, don't expect to break through enemy lines with it; rather, the Duke is capable of covering the flanks of the heaviest main battle tanks, and it does so with the elegance that only a noble duke can possess![/p][p][/p][p]Can you identify which tank the model is inspired by?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/7b3fdd7dbd3b67624c9838efb5d15c3f57b27c42.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/c22ae67f6aa7d67613f8d6a9f6c40c82bd4d3b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/84cc8161e24d64b075c1a18971ec73d4ffceb357.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/85433cef36275af3e84da3014c8b7f7d657e293a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/3bd22afa58bcc9833e94498261a3b7292b8811a4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/28a04b25aa2c2be45c6b091aefa4d964298813a1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Tyrannosaurus rex"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p][/p][p]Today, I present to you the king![/p][p]The emperor of the Cretaceous![/p][p]Testosterone incarnate in a giant reptile![/p][p]The one who makes water shake in glasses and eats people in toilets![/p][p]Introducing the [b]Tyrannosaurus rex[/b]!!![/p][p][/p][p]This gargantuan beast certainly needs no introduction![/p][p]Over 4 meters tall, weighing over 8 tons, and with the most powerful bite ever recorded in the history of land animals.[/p][p]Its eyesight is said to have been better than that of modern eagles, so yes, it would have seen you even if you were standing still! ...And who the hell started that rumor that the T. rex couldn't see stationary objects?! Imagine a giant dinosaur that's almost incapable of seeing trees and rocks because they're immobile.[/p][p][/p][p]In the game, I've gone a bit overboard with the height of our good reptile for scenic reasons, but I think you'll appreciate it.[/p][p]Like any other unit, you can either fight him or use him—the choice is yours.[/p][p]For now, his attack is a bite with very high penetrating power and a jump for area-of-effect damage.[/p][p]Would you add more?[/p][p]What do you think of this beast?[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD DINO IS A DEAD DINO![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/cd39875f09de3f64a51715ab1a211e2a83e3b2ad.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/84e5dc2024d66901f317c5d3752a850c7638b64b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/365775b67b40aef0f69a11e40e432eab5384ce09.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/cb7e79c12607396b56cbaea87007ec002fe63f7d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/ebd23e3e47bb7d523b470d9370f049bb7973e335.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/bd32288d268c8718dc3bab57ddea65ee10d3c0fc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Inflatable boat"
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p align="start"]Today, I present to you the "[b]Inflatable boat[/b]"![/p][p][/p][p]You'll say, "But it's just a dinghy!" ... just a dinghy???[/p][p]Let's give a quick example of a situation where this "it's just a dinghy!" would solve the battle:[/p][p]Time is running out, the Bugs/Dinosaurs/Military are about to conquer the last point, which would seal your defeat.[/p][p]Where is this point? On an islet! An islet? Yes, an islet![/p][p]How do you and your team get to this islet?[/p][p]- With a plane? Too expensive.[/p][p]- With a battleship? Too expensive and too slow.[/p][p]- Do you parachute using the respawn dynamic? First, you have to die, and then there's the wait.[/p][p]- Do you jump into a cannon to be shot? Your health might suffer.[/p][p]- With a jet ski? Okay, it's fast, but you'd be alone.[/p][p]- Do you use "it's just a dinghy!"? Exactly! It's cheap, very fast, can carry up to five soldiers, and can even be used to draw fire from enemy ships... but in that case, it's best only to have one member on board.[/p][p][/p][p]Now that I've given this example, I can tell you the truth... It's just a dinghy.[/p][p]However, I hope I've made you understand that even a small rubber dinghy can change the course of a battle on occasion.[/p][p]Of course, if there are two scorpions and a giant wasp at the capture point, and there are only five of you, well, save yourselves the trouble of the journey![/p][p][/p][p]Later, [b]I'll reveal the system for recalling vehicles to the battlefield[/b], which I think you'll really like![/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG ... IT'S JUST A DINGHY![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/ea99725722b93ff72cdb241857a48e70d3c2d8c5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/141ee014b637ace8dfa41073574759f2b83a68ac.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/58cc843cc5990218155f7c4cab41febc8f953a8c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/5f3de6267e04842a1e5c70056dffda16b3fa6c64.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Thor" + Artillery aiming system
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]Today, I present to you the "[b]Thor[/b]"![/p][p]Thor is a [b]self-propelled artillery gun that fires 155 mm high-explosive shells[/b].[/p][p]The evocative name is temporary, but if the community likes it, it could remain the service name.[/p][p]Although still in development, this powerful artillery piece has a five-round magazine that can fire in rapid succession, after which it must perform a moderate reloading.[/p][p]Intelligence is evaluating whether to equip this vehicle with other types of shells besides high-explosive ones. What do you think?[/p][p]Being an artillery vehicle, the Thor must remain in the rear, but thanks to its armor, it can withstand some enemy fire while waiting for reinforcements, as it has no defensive weapons to protect it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What about the artillery targeting system in the game?[/b][/p][p]As you can see in the photos, right-clicking will open a sort of minimap that will allow you to see a bird's-eye view of the area of the map you can target.[/p][p]For those curious, I was inspired by the artillery truck from BF4, which I thought was pretty cool... at least until they figured out where you were.[/p][p]Obviously, there's some dispersion to take into account due to the inaccuracy of the shots, which will vary depending on the vehicle and the distance to the target.[/p][p]If you have any thoughts on this system, now is the best time to talk about it.[/p][p]I really want to tell you that since I really love everything artillery-related, I'll take special care in its implementation, so that its use is as satisfying as possible for the player![/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/7504e7ea04df364fbf24147d158c1dbeede6d9b1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/79dfb1b28241b0b615bba4c0467677d0d24ed35b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/1bd42e32c0346f16367fe7ef40ff5f350c15c002.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/62915fb1d2aa097d5aaaad37a95ad1d9bd9d3f72.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/f2bde4a786a8f2d831853dd186cdbb72bba79c66.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MEET the "Formica rufa"!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Formica rufa[/b], often called the "[b]red ant[/b]" (but it's not the only one), is one of the insects in "Home Wars: Battlefield".[/p][p]This ant is small and fast, but despite its size, it has two powerful weapons. It can attack its enemies with its classic bite, but also with a secret weapon: formic acid![/p][p]The Formica rufa is one of the few insects in the world capable of throwing a dangerous substance it produces at its opponent, which creates a corrosive effect on the enemy's body.[/p][p]Alone, it may not be dangerous, but a group of Formica rufa is definitely not to be underestimated![/p][p]Therefore, when you come across this opponent, eliminate it as soon as possible, before it can become a serious threat![/p][p]The model of the toy soldier next to it gives you a better idea of the size of your enemy (which you can use yourself); however, there may be some change in the size of all units as the game develops.[/p][p][/p][p]Lately, I've been trying to make my way onto [b]X and TikTok[/b], too, to recruit as many soldiers as possible for this tough battle. So, if you're there, it would be great if you [b]liked my posts and commented on them[/b], so the algorithm knows my content is potentially valuable.[/p][p]Thank you all for your support, my friends![/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD ANT IS A DEAD ANT![/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/0cd33dad89c9866cc6288923d2f4beefe80e6fda.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/453792e9c8b69e3657f58bb0e2d45348af9ae083.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/daa8e7a8840975c7266bdbc983452a3e62c3cf83.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/e24b2646361109331f891d2134b9600a2d83b63a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/8c21e5357eeab4cbf0ea7e60f6ab1d376f5c8c0c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: NAVAL HUNTING!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p][/p][p]Today I'm sharing some screenshots of the [b]naval gameplay[/b], which I haven't fully developed yet, but it's just to give you an idea of what you'll find.[/p][p][/p][p]In the images, you can see:[/p][p]- a WW2 submarine that has just spotted another submarine and is preparing to fire a pair of torpedoes at it.[/p][p]- a WW2 submarine that has managed to take a WW2 destroyer from the side and is preparing to torpedo it.[/p][p]- the usual WW2 submarine that has intercepted a modern submarine from below and is studying the best method to sink it.[/p][p][/p][p]By the way, the modern submarine is strategic, meaning it's incapable of attacking other submarines, but it's devastating against land or naval surface targets.[/p][p]Let me know if you like the [b]underwater atmosphere[/b] I've created; the details are still missing, and Terrano is the one I use for testing, so it's very simple and monochrome.[/p][p]It won't be easy to develop balanced underwater gameplay, but, along with your advice, I'll give it my all, as I always have![/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD WATER BUG IS A DEAD WATER BUG![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/6f7f8db7db098a1433670f0cb69acfda48518db9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/e2dc2a338fc12bc68d667eaf44eac8a873a2b34c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266570/51cc0a5a17c806911432972b1a9b8bb3a17f0a01.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Giant Spider (Trichonephila senegalensis)!!!
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p][/p][p]I'm showing you the first [b]giant spider[/b]; it won't be the only one, and spiders won't be the only ones that are oversized... notes.title: How do you imagine the new cover?
notes.content: [p]Hello, soldiers![/p][p]I have created a lot of models (vehicles, planes, helicopters, ships, submarines, mechs, static defenses), so I am getting closer to creating the real cover of this game.[/p][p]I still have a low variety of models related to insects and dinosaurs, because I want to develop the combat system first.[/p][p][/p][p]Considering this progress in graphics, I can start thinking about how to set up the real cover of "Home Wars: Battlefield".[/p][p][/p][p]Although I already have some ideas, I would like to [b]brainstorm[/b] with you to see if we can come up with even better ones.[/p][p][/p][p]Consider that the main insects of HW1 will be there, but there will be many others, that there will be the most iconic dinosaurs, and that there will be both home maps and "real" maps like those of Battlefield, obviously with lower quality.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Every idea is welcome[/b], even the most extravagant![/p][p][/p][p]In the answers, [b]specify both the background and the various colors of the title[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who will participate in this discussion <3[/p][p][/p][h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: REVENGE!!!
notes.content:
[b]We have found thousands of our brothers lifeless ...[/b]
We don't know exactly who is responsible for this carnage, but we intend to find out!
Were they the disgusting Bugs? The arrogant Dinosaurs? Or some traitor in our Army?

[b]I have implemented ragdoll physics on the corpses of all the "biological" units[/b] to make them more fun to take down.

Unfortunately, the introduction of physics in the game and the multiplayer component have scaled down my expectations of total units in battle, but I am continuing to optimize everything to allow you to experience as much chaos as possible!

[b]Who do you want to face more? Bugs, Dinosaurs or Tan/Gray Army?[/b]

[h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3]

notes.title: Bot Navigation System: DONE!
notes.content:
Hello, soldiers!

[b]I just finished developing the bot navigation system.[/b]

If no changes are needed, the bots will not use a navmesh system for navigation but on sensors.
In this way the navigation of the units will be less "beautiful" but will be able to adapt to any terrain.
I made this choice because I did not want to discard the idea of ​​doing, very soon, the possibility of creating random maps whenever the player wants; as you understand, the navmesh does not adapt well to this feature.

[b]Another important decision I had to make is that all ground units, from soldiers to t-rexes, will be able to swim.[/b] Also all the ground vehicles will be able to cross the water, since they will be able to inflate a sort of mattress that will keep them afloat. Among other things I discovered that something similar was done by the Allies with the Shermans in WW2.
Obviously, the "aquatic" mode will make units and vehicles slower and more vulnerable.

Unfortunately I'm noticing that I absolutely won't be able to reach HW's numbers regarding bots on screen, both because of a greater complexity of the AI, and because of multiplayer.

[b]QUESTION:[/b] Considering the WORST scenario, would it be acceptable for you to have battles of about 75vs75, with 4 human players in co-op?

[b]Next step?[/b]
Now, I will start the part about the weapons in the first/third person.
In this step I might need your opinions, so every now and then check this page for surveys or simple questions from me.

[b]I have great ideas for this game[/b], I really hope you will like it so that we can continue the development well beyond the release!

[b]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/b]

notes.title: Unit Control System: DONE!
notes.content:
Hello, soldiers!

This is my first post for this game and I'm quite excited about it :D

I'm writing to update you on the development status.

I just finished the player control system for the units, both in first and third person.
The types of units involved are soldiers, tanks, wheeled vehicles, helicopters, planes, small boats, destroyers, submarines, mechs, walking bugs, jumping bugs, flying bugs, aquatic bugs, walking dinosaurs, flying dinosaurs, and aquatic dinosaurs.

HWB is my first real multiplayer game, so I have to solve unknown problems.

I mainly followed Battlefield 4 as an example of implementing vehicle controls, but obviously, there are some differences due to the needs of this gameplay.

For now, there will be only one type of vehicle control, which is why I tried to blend an arcade style with a slightly more realistic style.
Since this is a game that recreates the combat between plastic soldiers, insects, and dinosaurs, it didn't make much sense to focus on the realistic controls of the vehicles :D

The next step in development will be to create the navigation system for all these units for the bots, which is not an easy thing.

If you have any questions or suggestions, I'm always happy to hear from my players!

PS: The images I use for covers and marketing are generated using AI.
As soon as I have decent gameplay, I will replace them with images made by me, as I have done in all my other games.

THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!
